description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the Global Scan strategy, invoking `python3 scripts/fetch_news.py --source all --limit 15 --deep` to get a broad pool of ~16 items across all sources.
2. The agent applies Smart Time Filtering: it identifies only 3 items strictly within the 3-hour window (hn-001 at 1.5h, hn-002 at 2.8h, ws-001 at 2.1h), which is < 5, triggering Smart Fill. It selects high-heat supplementary items (e.g., hn-003 SQLite, ws-002 Gold, 36k-002 Kimi k2) from the wider 24h pool and annotates them with markers like '⚠️ 7h ago' or '🔥 24h Hot'.
3. CRITICAL GitHub Exception: The agent recognizes that all 5 GitHub Trending repos must be listed individually WITHOUT applying Smart Fill logic, and provides Deep Analysis for each — 核心价值, 启发思考, and 场景标签 (with #hashtag keywords) — even though all GitHub items are older than 3 hours.
4. Every news item title must be formatted as a Markdown link `[Title](URL)`, never as bare text.
5. The report is structured in Simplified Chinese with a Global Headlines section, Tech & AI section, and Finance section.
6. The report is saved to `reports/` with a timestamped filename matching pattern `YYYYMMDD_HHMM`.
